observed_pr.public_description:
## Purpose and task accounting

This closes the P8 corpus / external benchmark / once-holdout execution work with reproducible evidence and preserves its negative findings. It also fixes three integration defects found by independent review.

Current merged main is `a1158866c4efcfab402847d5c1ef72f4570e2779` (PR #153), with **162 / 192 original tasks done and 30 remaining**. P8-002 and P8-003 are already done through #153. This PR adds their larger reviewed corpus and frozen-run evidence and changes **only P8-004** to done. After final acceptance and merge, the result is **163 done / 29 remaining**, or **10 unique original TODOs completed in this session** from baseline `47d1939` (153 / 39). Original task IDs, definitions, steps, acceptance criteria and dependencies are preserved; scripts, tests, questions and follow-up issues are not counted as extra TODOs.

Closes #151. Incorporates the already merged #153 and the work tracked by #149 / #150.

## Product changes

- Coverage diagnostics respect the actual scanned path and hidden-file option. An admitted path absent from the index stays unknown; default hidden exclusions remain explicit.
- Scanner configuration combinations preserve metadata fallback, depth rules, token/signature equivalence and protected-hidden behavior. Regression tests demonstrate the original failures and the fix.
- Candidate packaging rejects `..` traversal and symlinked ancestor paths for every directory argument before creating output, while preserving the original disjoint-directory and build-evidence checks. Twelve real temporary-directory CLI cases and focused regression tests cover the boundary.

The two independently developed corpora remain separately frozen: 600 reviewed DEV queries here and 327 from #153 share 301 IDs, giving **626 unique queries**, not 927. Shared source bytes, annotation changes, related families and overlap are audited. This does not turn 626 queries into independent repository families or claim a new combined quality run.

## Immutable source / review / installation chain

| Stage | Actual GitHub commit |
| --- | --- |
| Reviewed combined product P | `1ed3c7df574db6d450f79ef29d5148f68556b3db` |
| Independent complete-source review R | `be8aabc0b35706f6403cc12961eb4149fda50f2c` |
| v14 review installation S | `714264adc8e3d38f0f25de16669de3fd363adeaa` |
| Final evidence and task head H | `b860db18dc2a2f509bd3acbffde640377695255e` |

Final H has tree `1db7c2e6d73f24076abb39ebd7497668fcf7b33a` and parents S plus merged main `a1158866`. All uploaded tree entries were verified against local modes and blob IDs. No product or validation source changed after S; the later delta is documentation, original execution evidence and task closeout metadata.

R covers all 1,082 product inputs and 110 exact validation inputs, including 312 changed-path authorship/review records. S changes only the four reviewed binding values and registry; the original v14 predicates, original 174 tests and CI definitions remain intact. The guard remains executable (100755). Frozen and locally executed SHAs are retained rather than relabeled as P or H.

## Validation already executed

On actual P:

- A fresh dev build produced binary SHA-256 `f149c9afc5df9d464c68a46d618040ef91a39d847a6c8dc641e7764c52a0dcd1`; all six workspace package builds were non-fresh.
- **13 distinct integration tests passed with zero ignored**: coverage diagnostics 9, real stdio MCP paging / path correspondence 2 (explicitly enabled), watcher behavior 2.
- Original `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` exited 0.
- All 1,196 observed execution inputs and the binary remained unchanged across the commands.

On actual S, the original v14 CLI executed once and exited 0, verifying P/R and the complete 1,082-input source set. All 1,197 observed inputs remained unchanged. These local runs do **not** replace final-head GitHub CI or the original 174-test CI execution.

Additional preserved evidence includes the scanner red/green tests, twelve real packager CLI controls, 32 corpus validation invocations, original default / HTTP / semantic regression runs, and previous source-guard execution. Their exact source identities, nonzero exits, ignored counts and observer corrections remain in the checkpoint.

## Completed experiments and their limits

**600-query DEV corpus:** six planned repositories, 600 native queries including 46 no-answer cases, 554 compatibility projections, 557 family labels and 308 reviewed source files. Compatibility projections are not additional questions, and family labels are not independent samples. All 20 original corpus validation commands passed. This is corpus certification evidence, not a full 600-query retrieval quality claim.

**Fixed external canonical campaign:** cc-switch and Flask, 100 original questions each, compatibility and native profiles kept separate. The frozen diagnostic runner produced **1,200 measured requests plus 400 warmups** across four runs. All four ended `invalid_measurement` / exit 2 because index coverage was incomplete. Original strict-F zero-row failures are retained. Scores are diagnostic only; no cross-system leaderboard, HTTP OCE result or release gate is claimed.

**Fresh once-holdout campaign:** the production F commit was frozen before a role-separated packet from new WalkDir / Click repository revisions was assembled and reviewed. It contains **64 EN/ZH queries in 32 paired families**, 56 positive and 8 no-answer queries. One run per repository, no retries or post-result tuning. Raw output was sealed before analysis and has not been rerun. Both runs ended `gate_failed` / exit 1; all 8 no-answer cases failed. Positive-query Top-1 is **10/56 (17.86%)**, with nDCG@10 **0.19053**. There are only 7 source-linked components across 2 repositories. This completes the once-holdout / anti-overfitting procedure while recording a negative quality outcome. The packet is now used and cannot be represented as unseen again.

All canonical and holdout measurements belong to their recorded frozen **F / D** source and binary identities. **Quality on the newly merged product P is not_run.** Full V19 / G8, release readiness, 100k scale and live-provider certification are not granted.

The original procfs namespace mismatch is tracked separately in #155. Original benchmark timing failures (including #153 attempt 1) remain available and are not silently reclassified as flakes or erased by later passes. #154 retains the earlier cold-client ownership synchronization follow-up.

## Evidence entry points

- [Benchmark index](artifacts/benchmarks/p8-corpus-external-holdout-20261008/README.md): six real execution entries and hashes of the two delivered raw archives.
- [Complete closeout checkpoint](artifacts/checkpoints/p8-corpus-external-holdout-20261008/README.md): source identities, reviews, raw-seal metadata, score replays, corpus provenance, preserved failures and build receipts.
- [Round-by-round original TODO accounting](artifacts/checkpoints/p8-corpus-external-holdout-20261008/round-counts.json).
- [Final product validation](artifacts/checkpoints/p8-corpus-external-holdout-20261008/round5/final-product-validation/).
- [Final S guard validation](artifacts/checkpoints/p8-corpus-external-holdout-20261008/round5/final-S-guard-validation/).

The selected public checkpoint was checked for full canonical / used-holdout query bodies; none were found. That check is scoped to this selection, not every inherited repository file. The complete sealed raw outputs and three original binaries are in the hash-verified delivery archives. The final dev binary is an observed build intermediate, not a published release.

## Final merge gate

**Pending on exact final H:** the original CI, engineering-excellence and semantic-closeout workflows, including original source-integrity tests and v14 CLI, plus independent final task acceptance. Earlier successful runs on old `d5dfebd4` do not satisfy this gate. No new main completion is claimed until these checks are accepted and this PR is merged.
